findings.title: Resealed cross-host redirect history passes replay
findings.observation: A valid offline county batch was changed only in temporary event/header/reservation/report hashes. Arapahoe redirect response and its next reservation were replaced by a URL on the separately allowed Weld hostname. verify_run returned completed with Arapahoe observation.response_url on www.weld.gov. No public request occurred; original fixture transport used only injected bytes. Runtime reserve() correctly rejects this change, but ledger() replay checks only general HOSTS and follow-up equality.
findings.remedy: During replay, require every reservation hostname to equal the source target hostname, in addition to the exact first URL and chained redirect checks. Keep terminal refused external redirects as recorded failure evidence; never accept a followed cross-host reservation. Test resealed coherent fixture and a valid same-host positive control.

findings.title: Resealed overlong per-request deadline passes replay
findings.observation: The second reservation deadline was changed from +30 to +200 seconds; its complete PDF result and later event/report timestamps were changed consistently to +70 seconds. All remain inside the +300 run deadline. verify_run returned completed even though request_seconds is 30. Checking result.finished_at only against the altered reservation deadline does not enforce the pinned per-request maximum.
findings.remedy: Require reservation.deadline == min(run.deadline, reservation.reserved_at + timedelta(seconds=plan.limits.request_seconds)) during replay, then retain strict complete-before-deadline validation. Test overlong, equality and narrower-limit runs without weakening timeout/partial evidence.
